en: A black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle complex rising above dense forest. The structure has multiple connected stone buildings with steep gabled roofs, several round and square defensive towers, and a tall central keep with a pointed roof. The landscape below is heavily wooded, with distant hills faintly visible on the left. There is no visible text on the image.
